bumperPavilion.note: Keep car center within inset polygon and allow room for rubber bumpers. Front sprite has identical canvas and anchor.

bumperCars.note: Seat positions refer to butt/cushion contact; do not use as head centers. Only front SE/SW orientations provided.

balloonRide.note: Animate four gondolas around a runtime base and arms. Complete preview already contains four baskets and must not be drawn concurrently. For each basket draw gondola then actual riders then front wall.

limitations: Animals have one pose per direction; use runtime translation, subtle bob and tilt, not a multi-frame walk.
Bumper car has front SE/SW views only; SE mirrors SW and therefore also mirrors baked lighting.
Balloonride is a complete static preview. Animate individual balloon-gondola sprites around a procedural base/arms; do not simultaneously draw complete preview.
Pavilion is one fixed southeast view. Draw complete pavilion, moving cars/riders, then bumper-pavilion-front for roof/post occlusion.
Buildings use measured ground-plane centers, not bottommost opaque pixels. Apply SpriteSpec anchors without retrimming.
Only architectural sprites are provided for playground; interactive children/3D geometry remain runtime work.
